chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, sent a man for a need, and he was walking in the sun. So he said to him: “Walk in the shade, for indeed the shade is blessed.”

key_terms.الشَّمْسِ: the sun, indicating direct heat and exposure
key_terms.الظِّلِّ: the shade, a place of relief and blessing
key_terms.حَاجَةٍ: a need or task to be fulfilled
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say about walking in the shade?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله advised a man to walk in the shade rather than in direct sunlight. It reflects prophetic concern for well-being and conveys that shade is a blessed provision.
